blocks.html: Cabo Fishing Reports – Real Fishing Stories from San José del Cabo

Real Fishing Adventures from Puerto Los Cabos Marina

Every fishing trip has its own story, and some of the best moments happen when you least expect them!

Discover real fishing adventures, memorable catches, and unforgettable experiences shared by our guests aboard Exotic Fish Cabo private fishing charters.

From powerful yellowfin tuna and lightning-fast wahoo to colorful dorado (mahi-mahi), roosterfish, snapper, and other seasonal species, the waters around San José del Cabo always have something exciting to offer.

Our fishing reports bring these adventures to life through authentic stories, photos, and memorable moments on the water.

Whether you're an experienced angler or planning your first fishing trip, explore what makes sportfishing in Los Cabos such a unique experience.

Of course, every day on the ocean is different. Weather, currents, water temperature, and seasonal fish activity influence fishing opportunities, and catches are never guaranteed.

All Exotic Fish Cabo fishing charters depart exclusively from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, Baja California Sur, Mexico. Guests staying in Cabo San Lucas are also welcome to join our private 6-hour and 8-hour fishing adventures.

Ready to create your own fishing story?

Explore our Fishing Calendar to discover seasonal fishing opportunities, or browse our Private Fishing Charters to plan your next adventure.

San Jose del Cabo Fishing Log — October 19–25, 2026

Yellowfin tuna fishing remained inconsistent around San Jose del Cabo during October 19–25, although a 180-pound tuna was reported at Vinorama and activity improved around Inner Gordo toward the weekend. Wahoo began appearing more regularly, while large grouper, snapper and changing bait supplies highlighted the importance of flexible fishing plans.
